messages:
Maria: quick FYI, ran a private deploy dry-run in eu-ams and my RBAC tweak for `priv-rotator` caused intermittent failures during control-plane -> HSM handshake. Keystore proxy logs show 403 and audit forwarder queued messages. :eyes:
Ajay: can you paste the sanitized proxy + forwarder logs? need to know authz vs netpol.
Maria: pasted snippet:
```
2026-03-20T09:12:01Z keystore-proxy ERROR authz: denied principal=service:cp-vpc scope=encrypt reason=rbac:missing_action
2026-03-20T09:12:02Z audit-forwarder WARN enqueue failed: connection refused to 10.10.254.7:6514
```
Kevin: seems like two independent failures: RBAC removed `encrypt` from rotator, and audit egress to SIEM is blocked by network policy.
Olivia: Maria, confirm env — eu-ams private deploy with hybrid VPC-onprem and jump-proxy? we funnel SIEM through egress-proxy at 10.10.254.7, right?
Maria: yes. I tightened the `priv-rotator` role last week; the candidate policy accidentally dropped `keystore:encrypt`. I reverted it but audit-forwarder still has backlog.
Samir: backlog is a compliance issue. We need a safe canary fallback so rotations arent blocked during RBAC rollouts. Proposal: a scoped temporary allow `keystore:encrypt` with `when=rotation-window` for canaries.
Ajay: +1. Also netpol: audit-forwarder pod lacks egress to the SIEM. quick networkpolicy patch suggestion:
```
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: allow-audit-egress
spec:
  podSelector: {matchLabels: {app: audit-forwarder}}
  policyTypes: [Egress]
  egress:
  - to:
    - ipBlock: {cidr: 10.10.254.0/24}
    ports: [{protocol: TCP, port: 6514}]
```
Kevin: fine, but some tenants use `deny-egress: true` via CNI at namespace level. We should enforce via ClusterNetworkPolicy or specific CNI annotations so it isn't dropped.
Olivia: related vuln triage: our scanner flagged `netagent v2.4.1` for CVE-2026-1987 (conntrack race while applying rules). If netagent races with a netpol apply, existing flows can be dropped causing forwarder reconnect loops. Need a patch schedule.
Maria: are there mitigations to avoid a dual-failure (RBAC + netpol+netagent race)? sequence upgrades?
incident-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: INC-2026-452 (private-deploy-audit-egress-failures). triage lead: @Kevin.
Kevin: taking triage. initial plan:
- rollback RBAC delta for priv-rotator (done)
- apply audit egress NetworkPolicy in staged clusters
- upgrade netagent to v2.4.3 (contains fix) with drain-and-roll to avoid conntrack race
- validate audit backlog drained and that connections show TLS handshake success
Ajay: log checks to confirm:
- audit-forwarder logs show `TLS handshake completed` and `peer: siem.example.local`
- SIEM ingest shows event timestamps match original event times
Samir: compliance needs a signed proof for the downtime window. We can export an append-only digest of the audit-forwarder queue and upload it to the control-plane S3 bucket (encrypted). Attach to incident.
Olivia: note about HSM fallback: some onprem installs keep HSM in an offline fallback mode. If keystore-proxy can't reach HSM, should we ever fall back to SW keys for rotation? high risk.
Maria: ops stance: fail-closed in prod (no SW fallback) but allow scoped fallback in sandbox/test for recovery drills. We'll add to the runbook.
Kevin: action owners and ETAs:
- Kevin: incident timeline + runbook edits, include `rbac-rollout-checklist` (ETA 3h)
- Ajay: apply netpol patch and open k8s PR for ClusterNetworkPolicy (ETA 1h)
- Olivia: schedule netagent 2.4.3 rollout with canary plan and drain guidance (ETA EOD)
- Samir: generate compliance digest and attach to INC-2026-452 (ETA 2h)
Maria: I'll prepare a customer-facing note on the private deployment dry-run and confirm SLA impact (likely none; need to quantify backlog). :thumbsup:
Kevin: small checklist to add to RBAC rollout guide:
- run `rback-sim` locally to ensure `keystore:encrypt` remains granted to `priv-rotator`
- health probe: `POST /v1/keystore/rotate` with test creds
- ensure `audit-forwarder` egress rule exists in target namespace
- confirm netagent version >= 2.4.3 on nodes hosting audit-forwarder
Ajay: also add alerting: if audit queue > 1h, page @security-oncall and open an incident.
Olivia: I'll update deploy-bot to tag netagent 2.4.3 in the release window.
deploy-bot: noted. release note updated: "netagent -> 2.4.3 (fixes CVE-2026-1987)." :white_check_mark:
Samir: after fixes, confirm `audit-forwarder status` shows:
```
connections: 1
peer: siem.example.local:6514 (tls)
queue_depth: 0
last_sent: 2026-03-20T10:45:12Z
```
Maria: thanks all. Kevin, once the runbook is updated include the exact `kubectl` commands used for oncall reproduction (e.g., `kubectl -n priv apply -f allow-audit-egress.yaml`).
Kevin: will attach patch and backport to legacy manifests.
Ajay: I'll write a short postmortem after INC closure focusing on RBAC CI guardrails and netpol test harness.
Maria: closing notes: no customer data exfil, no key compromise, HSM logs show denied ops only during a ~5m window. closing once INC-2026-452 moves to resolved.
incident-bot: INC-2026-452 status -> TRIAGED (assignee: Kevin).
